theorem QOU.CentralExtension.Cech.split_pull_bijective {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type} {U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X} {v : ι} {A B : TopologicalSpace.Opens X} {G : Type} [TopologicalSpace G] [CommGroup G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] (hA : A ≤ U v) (hB : B ≤ U v) (hcov : U v ≤ A ⊔ B) (hU : ConnFamily U) (hU' : ConnFamily (splitFam U v A B)) :

theorem QOU.CentralExtension.Cech.split_surj_core {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type} {U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X} {v : ι} {A B : TopologicalSpace.Opens X} {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] (hA : A ≤ U v) (hB : B ≤ U v) (hcov : U v ≤ A ⊔ B) (hU : ConnFamily U) (V' : Option ι → Option ι → Option ι → M) (hV' : ∀ (x y z w : Option ι), N4 (splitFam U v A B) x y z w → V' x y z + V' x z w = V' y z w + V' x y w) :
∃ (V : ι → ι → ι → M) (u : Option ι → Option ι → M), (∀ (i j k l : ι), N4 U i j k l → V i j k + V i k l = V j k l + V i j l) ∧ ∀ (x y z : Option ι), N3 (splitFam U v A B) x y z → V (splitR v x) (splitR v y) (splitR v z) = V' x y z + (u x y + u y z - u x z)

theorem QOU.CentralExtension.Cech.split_inj_core {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type} {U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X} {v : ι} {A B : TopologicalSpace.Opens X} {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] (hA : A ≤ U v) (hB : B ≤ U v) (hcov : U v ≤ A ⊔ B) (hU : ConnFamily U) (D : ι → ι → ι → M) (hD : ∀ (i j k l : ι), N4 U i j k l → D i j k + D i k l = D j k l + D i j l) (z' : Option ι → Option ι → M) (hz : ∀ (x y z : Option ι), N3 (splitFam U v A B) x y z → D (splitR v x) (splitR v y) (splitR v z) = z' x y + z' y z - z' x z) :
